6 تعاقدوا They united in a contract, a compact, a covenant, an agreement, a league, a treaty, or an engagement, (S, O, K,) فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمْ [respecting the matter between them]. (S, O.) ―
-b2- تعاقدت الكِلَابُ The dogs stuck fast together in coupling. (S, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
